state.seed_assertion: The DPIA should be conducted before the processing begins.

sentences.1: The DPIA should be conducted before the processing begins.
sentences.2: The DPIA should be conducted before the processing begins and should be considered as a living tool, not merely as a one-off exercise.
sentences.3: Even if a DPIA is not required on 25 May 2018, it will be necessary, at the appropriate time, for the controller to conduct such a DPIA as part of its general accountability obligations.
sentences.4: Therefore, even if a DPIA is not required on 25 May 2018, it will be necessary, at the appropriate time, for the controller to conduct such a DPIA as part of its general accountability obligations.
sentences.5: It is a data controller's obligation to ensure a DPIA is carried out when required, at the appropriate time and contains all the detail required by the GDPR.
sentences.6: It is important to remember that it is a data controller's obligation to ensure a DPIA is carried out when required, at the appropriate time and contains all the detail required by the GDPR.
sentences.7: The mere fact that the conditions triggering the obligation to carry out DPIA have not been met does not diminish controllers' general obligation to implement measures to appropriately manage risks for the rights and freedoms of data subjects.
sentences.8: The mere fact that the conditions triggering the obligation to carry out DPIA have not been met does not, however, diminish controllers' general obligation to implement measures to appropriately manage risks for the rights and freedoms of data subjects.
